generator.cost_basis: User approved same-model local A6000 generation; no external generation API charge.

filter.parameter_provenance: Memory rules from f8508da:project/configs/pm_v2.yaml; memory-only adaptation; no outcome-based tuning for this run.

analysis.estimand: Mean over all 204 fixed states; equal state weights.
analysis.bootstrap: Sample clusters with replacement; include all states in each sampled cluster; weighted ratio preserves state-mean estimand.
planned_contrasts: ON minus OFF for each policy
PM minus Rule and PM minus Fixed at each filter setting
analysis.missing_observations: No final table until all 204 x 6 x 3 valid main observations are present.
analysis.inference_scope: Descriptive paired 95% intervals; no adjusted simultaneous coverage or guaranteed superiority.

pilot.selection_rule: Seed/turn strata sorted; choose two distinct users per cell in SHA256(seed:unit_id) order, excluding previously chosen users. No outcome or price selection.
pilot.purpose: Technical and rubric cross-check only; twelve units do not establish equivalence to GPT-4o or human raters.

budget.submission_rule: Before every submission or retry: charged usage + unresolved/queued reservations + new request output-cap reservation must be <=9 USD. Recount actual generated text first. Do not assume usage-unknown failures cost zero. Stop before submitting work that exceeds the limit.

execution.generation_order: frozen unit order, then frozen arm order
execution.generation_reuse: Pilot replies reused in main; identical request hash required.
execution.unknown_usage: Keep reservation and stop; never implicitly resubmit.

pilot_gate.order_gate_provenance: v1 evo_response_v4.run_response_v4 defaults; applied to both judges.
pilot_gate.reference_gate_provenance: New operational screening thresholds fixed before any outputs; not established equivalence criteria.
pilot_gate.failure_action: Stop before full scoring; preserve all pilot scores; no outcome-directed parameter changes.

amendment.reason: NVIDIA first generation request returned HTTP 410, model EOL 2026-08-26. User explicitly approved local A6000 recovery.
amendment.authorization: User: 可以的，推进吧。 (approval of same 8B local recovery proposal)
changes: Generation endpoint and numerical serving backend
Pinned mirror tokenizer template and per-request token hashes
Local service attestation before generation and in every generation response
unchanged: Weights identical to official Meta shard hashes
All generation messages, temperature, max_tokens and seeds
OpenAI pricing, 9 USD limit and statistical definitions
amendment.limit: No claim that local numerical execution or tokenizer wrapper is bit-identical to retired NVIDIA service.

eos_amendment.authorization: User: 好的，解除限制，重跑后，开始表3的分析。
eos_amendment.generation_rule: Greedy generation until EOS; no experiment-level output-token cutoff. Native model context ceiling exhaustion is an error, not a valid truncated response.
eos_amendment.selection: All 28 length-stopped responses, all six arms, selected solely by saved stop reason.
eos_amendment.integrity: Same inputs, weights, tokenizer, dtype, decoder and seeds; exact original 100-token prefix required.
eos_amendment.scores: Reuse only byte-identical request bodies; retain superseded scores and all prior charges; update both pilot judges and apply original gates.
eos_amendment.main: All 204 states and six arms; same judge, schema, metrics, bootstrap and budget as parent.

wire_amendment.reason: Repair observed Batch schema-property reordering relative to synchronous pilot.
wire_amendment.wire_order: Native Pydantic schema property declaration order, preserved in exact submitted JSON.
wire_amendment.main_score_reuse: Re-evaluate all 2652 main jobs uniformly; exclude every older main score.
wire_amendment.pilot_score_reuse: Reuse identical synchronous pilot requests, which already used native order.
wire_amendment.other_changes: None to replies, model, rubric, score fields, thresholds, sampling, bootstrap, maximum attempts or cumulative budget.
